page.overview:
Who is Bill Reader?

Bill Reader is a neighbor of the Simpson family.

Bill appeared in Simpsons Comics 94, wherein he had recently moved in near to the Simpson family. Bart Simpson let the Readers know that Mayor Quimby had recently passed a law making all businesses in Springfield open 24 hours.

Lisa Simpson mistakenly thought he was talking to her, and told him that she already knew, but he explained he was talking to "the Readers". Since the dialogue of the comics is written in all caps, this initially seemed to refer to the readers of the comic, until the family made an appearance on the next panel.

Bill explained to Lisa that he and his wife and daughter were the Simpsons' new neighbours, and thanked Bart for keeping them up to speed.
